name: Sylvester Sheet Metal
old_description: Sylvester Sheet Metal is a local residential and commercial HVAC company that specializes in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning installation and service.  We have been in business for over 70 years. about:
Sylvester Sheet Metal operates from West Warwick, Rhode Island, where it has served residential and commercial customers for more than 70 years. The company’s founding year and original owners are not publicly documented, and no information about family, veteran, or minority ownership is available.

The business provides heating, ventilation, and air conditioning installation and service for both residential and commercial clients. Its offerings include heater and air conditioning repair, full system installation, mini-split service and repair, and duct design and installation. The company also identifies as an authorized installer, though specific brand authorizations are not listed. No facility size, employee count, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Sylvester Sheet Metal works with homeowners, building owners, and commercial contractors across the region. Its service area covers residential and light commercial projects, though specific industry sectors beyond HVAC are not detailed. The company does not publish a client list or case studies.

The company states that it offers a wide range of services to meet diverse customer needs and provides free estimates for prospective jobs. Its longevity of over 70 years is highlighted as a marker of experience. The company’s website emphasizes professional service and free estimates for all inquiries, positioning itself as a local provider for a wide range of HVAC needs.
